zh: 没装 FULI 的人，凭一条访客链接就能只读地问你的一个项目。
配对的电脑可以把活交给你这边的助手，在单独的副本里做，由你拍板。
每条消息前 FULI 的钩子快了约半秒；更新失败不会再让 FULI 起不来。
en: Someone without FULI can ask one of your projects, read-only, through a guest link.
A paired computer can hand work to your assistant; it is done in a separate copy and you decide.
The hook is about half a second faster per message; a failed update no longer stops FULI starting.
